summary: Iteration 95: Daily tracking system for Poids & Nutrition page. Backend 100% (15/15 tests passed). Frontend 100% working - all track buttons, progress bar, streak badge, and persistence verified.
critical_code_review_comments: minceur_routes.py: Clean implementation of toggle_tracking(), get_today_tracking(), and tracking in weight-details
minceur.tsx: Optimistic UI updates with toggleTrack() - UI updates immediately, then syncs with backend
Streak calculation correctly counts consecutive days with at least 1 tracked item
data-testid attributes correctly implemented: daily-progress, track-meal-{0-3}, track-exercise-{0-1}
seed_data_creation: Test created tracking data via API calls (meal_0, meal_1, exercise_0, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily tracking feature fully working. Track buttons at data-testid='track-meal-{i}' and 'track-exercise-{i}'. Progress bar at data-testid='daily-progress' shows done/total count and streak badge. Background color changes to rgb(16, 185, 129) (GREEN) when tracked. Tracking persists in minceur_tracking MongoDB collection.

backend_endpoints.POST /api/minceur/track: PASS - Toggles meal/exercise as done/undone for today
backend_endpoints.GET /api/minceur/today-tracking: PASS - Returns completed map, streak, week_adherence, days_tracked
backend_endpoints.GET /api/minceur/weight-details: PASS - Now includes tracking.completed and tracking.streak

frontend_components.daily-progress: PASS - Shows 'Suivi du jour' with done/total count (e.g., 4/6) and streak badge
frontend_components.track-meal-0 to track-meal-3: PASS - All 4 meal check buttons found and clickable
frontend_components.track-exercise-0 to track-exercise-1: PASS - Both exercise check buttons found and clickable
frontend_components.toggle_visual_change: PASS - Button bg changes from rgba(255,255,255,0.04) to rgb(16,185,129) GREEN when tracked
frontend_components.strikethrough_text: PASS - Meal/exercise names get strikethrough when tracked
frontend_components.progress_bar_updates: PASS - Count updates instantly on toggle (optimistic UI)
frontend_components.persistence: PASS - Tracking data persists after page reload

toggle_functionality.toggle_on: PASS - Clicking untracked item marks it as done, turns green
toggle_functionality.toggle_off: PASS - Clicking tracked item marks it as undone, turns back to default
toggle_functionality.count_update: PASS - Progress bar count updates immediately on each toggle

mocked_apis.note: All APIs use real data from MongoDB minceur_tracking collection
